releases.notes:
StorageLens 1.0.7 supports Fabric on Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3.

- Add a dedicated 26.3 target with the new RenderPearl texture types and SDL keyboard backend while retaining shared behavior across all targets.
- Bundle the official MoulConfig 26.3 source port from pinned revision 4eaeb73cdaeb, with verified source download, reproducible builds, distinct keyboard/mouse bindings and correct Fabric access-widener discovery.
- Preserve existing search bindings when upgrading from GLFW to SDL by storing stable key names and migrating legacy numeric values.
- Keep release jobs on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu; install JDK 8 for MoulConfig common sources and JDK 25 for Minecraft builds.

Validation: full three-target builds and existing JUnit tests; separate Fabric smoke runs for each version verify production mixin application, MoulConfig linkage and rendering pipeline initialization. Gameplay on a live Hypixel server was not tested.

releases.notes:
StorageLens 1.0.6 reduces stuttering when closing chests.

### What changed

- Closing a chest no longer compresses and writes all remembered island chests
  and storage pages on the game thread.
- Changed observations are saved in the background after a short delay, with
  pending saves combined so only the latest contents are written.
- Unchanged observations skip serialization, and open containers avoid repeated
  item-stack copies when their contents have not changed.
- Pending saves finish before profile changes, cache clearing, and shutdown to
  preserve profile isolation and prevent cleared data from reappearing.

Available for Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2 on Fabric.

releases.notes:
StorageLens 1.0.5 fixes storage refreshes and duplicate armor ownership in Item Search.

### What changed

- Opening an Ender Chest, backpack, or other supported storage now replaces its
  cached contents, including when another mod displays a custom container
  overlay.
- Empty slots are recorded during refreshes so removed items no longer remain
  in search results.
- Equipment and wardrobe references remain searchable but no longer increase
  owned item counts or estimated value.
- Equipped armor and its matching wardrobe entry are treated as the same item,
  while genuinely separate copies still count separately.
- Removed the stale-data `!` marker from item locations.

releases.notes:
StorageLens 1.0.4 fixes duplicate ownership and stale storage locations in Item Search.

### What changed

- Loadout items remain searchable but no longer increase owned item counts or
  estimated value.
- Museum items that have been borrowed and are held elsewhere no longer appear
  as stored in the Museum.
- Moving items from Ender Chest or backpack pages into the player inventory now
  removes their old storage locations immediately.
